test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: HFIJ is related to ECFG in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, WUXY is related to TRUV. Which of the following is NLOP related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 
• HFIJ is related to ECFG

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/319d86ca5d14a6679d71f637b593caa9abe9648ab4c08bf11aeb9ebc6e0e8b60.png] 

​And,

 
• WUXY is related to TRUV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a60144083cda676632815dbbad2ca38424b391b14ad3aaba53b9375a7c3fc044.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• NLOP is related to ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dea139ce131b91479504605257d27ae605a0f587bccbe83b55d4f027bb72685f.png] 

Hence, "**KILM**" is the correct answer.
